description_en: Queries the list of database anti-ransomware policies
description_zh: 查询数据库防勒索策略列表
name: DescribeUniBackupPolicies

parameters.help_en: The name of the database anti-ransomware backup policy
parameters.help_zh: 数据库防勒索备份策略的名称
parameters.name: policy_name

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries to display per page for a paginated query. The default number of entries per page is 20. If the PageSize parameter is left empty, 20 entries are returned by default.
We recommend that you do not leave PageSize empty
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number from which to start displaying query results. Default value: 1, which indicates that query results are displayed starting from page 1
parameters.help_zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示
parameters.name: current_page

Count.description_en: The number of database anti-ransomware policies displayed on the current page
Count.description_zh: 当前页面显示的数据库防勒索策略的数量

CurrentPage.description_en: The page number of the current page in a paginated query
CurrentPage.description_zh: 分页查询时，显示的当前页的页码

PageSize.description_en: The number of database anti-ransomware policies displayed per page in a paginated query
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时，每页显示的数据库防勒索策略的数量

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of database anti-ransomware policies
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的数据库防勒索策略的总数量

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use the ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

UniBackupPolicies.description_en: The collection of database anti-ransomware backup policies
UniBackupPolicies.description_zh: 数据库防勒索备份策略集合

items.description_en: The information about a database anti-ransomware backup policy
items.description_zh: 数据库防勒索备份策略信息

AgentErrorMessage.description_en: The error message of the client exception

AgentStatus.description_en:
The status of the database client agent. Valid values:
UNKNOWN: Unknown.
INSTALLED: Installed.
INSTALL_FAILED: Installation failed.
UNINSTALL_FAILED: Uninstallation failed
AgentStatus.description_zh:
数据库客户端代理的状态。取值包括：
UNKNOWN：未知
INSTALLED：已安装
INSTALL_FAILED：安装失败
UNINSTALL_FAILED：卸载失败

DatabaseType.description_en:
The type of the database. Valid values:

MYSQL
MSSQL
Oracle
DatabaseType.description_zh:
数据库类型，取值如下：

MYSQL
MSSQL
Oracle

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned when the backup plan execution fails
ErrorCode.description_zh: 备份计划执行失败返回错误Code信息

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message of the backup policy

InstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the server

InstanceName.description_en: The name of the server instance

InstanceStatus.description_en:
The status of the ECS instance. Valid values:

Stopped: Stopped.
Running: Running
InstanceStatus.description_zh:
ECS实例状态。取值：

Stopped：已停止
Running：运行中

InstanceUuid.description_en: The unique identifier of the server database backup client
InstanceUuid.description_zh: 服务器数据库备份客户端唯一标识

LatestBackResult.description_en: The result of the latest backup plan execution
LatestBackResult.description_zh: 最新备份计划执行结果

LatestBackupTime.description_en: The time when the latest backup plan was executed
LatestBackupTime.description_zh: 最新备份计划执行时间

PlanStatus.description_en:
The status of the backup plan. Valid values:

init: Being initialized.
running: Running.
completed: Completed.
restoring: Being restored.
creating: Being created.
created: Created
PlanStatus.description_zh:
备份计划状态，取值如下：

init：初始化中
running：执行中
completed：执行完成
restoring：恢复中
creating：创建中
created：创建成功

PolicyId.description_en: The ID of the database anti-ransomware backup policy
PolicyId.description_zh: 数据库防勒索备份策略的ID

PolicyName.description_en: The name of the database anti-ransomware backup policy
PolicyName.description_zh: 数据库防勒索备份策略的名称

PolicyStatus.description_en:
The status of the database anti-ransomware backup policy. Valid values:

initiating: Being initialized.
opening: Being enabled.
closing: Being disabled.
deleting: Being deleted.
enabled: Enabled.
disabled: Disabled
PolicyStatus.description_zh:
数据库防勒索备份策略状态，取值：

initiating：初始化中
opening：开启中
closing：关闭中
deleting：删除中
enabled：已启用
disabled：已禁用

UniRegionId.description_en: The region ID of the database server
UniRegionId.description_zh: 数据库服务器所在的地域ID
